SIGMA fp — fpSup-Formats, six resolutions in one menu (v0.3.0a)
banner: fpSup-Fmt-v0.3.0a!
firmware: SIGMA fp Ver.5.02 only

AutoRun.txt  32,772B  sha256=0ab3d3009cb3883e842b97d3f8431275fe4d9022fec49a443bf753f1ef7ee109
fpSup.BIN    32,768B  sha256=e0b22de9e4699396a30af124f1038f820055c02ec9b2aee2579fe90443542caa

Built 2026-09-28 with fp_usb_shell/build_autorun.py --loader --no-shell (loader and stage2 of
2026-09-25: journal of every firmware word outside the cave, written back at power-off).
AutoRun 118 commands; it differs from fpsup-og3k-v0.2.6a's AutoRun.txt only in the three
banner lines.  stage2 is byte for byte the one in fpsup-og3k-v0.2.6a (864 B).

payload magic: VBIN
payload sections: 106 = stage2 (in file) + 105 placed sections, 22,736 B of payload
payload entry: none (0).  The boot-time apply runs from the canvas hook, ~600 frames after
  the card loads; no entry, no pool, no task, no power-off routine of its own.
USB shell: absent.  fpSup.BIN is byte for byte the camera-tested rc10
  (Releases/fpsup-formats-v0.3.0rc10, AutoRun sha256=ed78b700f768f0c1…, banner fpSup-Fmt-v0.3.0rc!); only the
  AutoRun banner text changed for the release.  A debug twin with the current shell can be
  made with pack_release.py --debug; none is published.

Lineage.  The 105 sections are, byte for byte and in the same order, the sections of the
research card 20260928-og3k-registry-rel10 (fpSup.BIN sha256=415953a9…) minus its ten USB-shell
sections.  rel10 = format set `formats_rel.py` (S16, OG2K, OG3K, OG3.5K; enums 5, 7, 4, 9) on
the six-row UI base 20260928-og3k-menu6-s16d (build_ui6.py with UI_STATES; sha256=35e5a322…),
registry code v4p (build_reg.py).  Nothing was reassembled for this release.
repack: projects/open-gate/build/registry/pack_release.py (research tree).

Sections by kind (addresses are ARM virtual, image base 0xC0000000):
  cave 0xC072FB00..0xC0734C84 (not journaled): picker table 0xC072FB00 (32 keys: 4 formats x
    8 rates), tokens 0xC0730440 (S16, OG2K, OG3K, OG35K), routines 0xC0730500..0xC07328C0
    (regfrmax 0xC0730500, regcropeff 0xC0730600, regcropstate 0xC0730680, regfmt 0xC0730800,
    regnom 0xC0730A00, regsel 0xC0731800, regname 0xC0731A00, regaspect2 0xC0731B40, regout
    0xC0731D00, regaspect 0xC0731F00, regapply 0xC0731F60, regfrclass 0xC07322A0, regcanvas
    0xC0732400, regseltail 0xC0732760, reggs 0xC0732900, cropnocache stub 0xC07304E0),
    column/stock/value tables 0xC0730C10..0xC0731240 (48 setter cells: donors p13 and p171,
    16 cells each incl. k19/k20 and k49/k50, six preview heights, padding), registry
    0xC0731240 (7 x 0x40: four rows + stock + two empty), canvas lists 0xC0731400 (record,
    playback, S16 standby), flags 0xC0731C00..0xC0731C30, enum pair table 0xC0731C40 (six
    pairs), UI state 0xC0732700, UI runtime 0xC0732C84 (7,512 B)
  outside the cave (journaled, restored at power-off): UI pack 0xC0793060 (6,956 B), CSV text
    0xC0F8E7EC (92 B), long menu CSV 0xC12C7CF8 (156 B), NBR directory entry 0xC0D4DE04 (8 B),
    Settings controller max 0xC1A709BC (5.0), 32 PARAM words 0xC0BD9A2C..0xC0BE1DE4 (as in
    fpsup-og3k), crop descriptor vtable word 0xC07426F8, resolution refresh list 0xC0CDC058
    (ROM; its RAM copy is written by the canvas hook at run time), enum converter code words
    0xC06BDA3C/40/48
  hook words (branches into the cave, placed last):
    C005C020 resolution setter, C043CCF8 format picker, C0437B48 name emitter, C043A19C canvas,
    C0306EA0 / C0306EEC aspect, C0437E98 output descriptor, C03A6DD8 gain, C043D258,
    C0437AF8, C043BE68, C02092CC, C0218AEC, C0219260, C03AA568, C05E84D8, C05E6400, C05E5B58
    (as in v0.1.0a), C04A121C regfrclass (frame-rate list state by the row's max rate),
    C00A87E4 regfrmax (frame-rate normaliser cap), C04A1788 regcropstate (Crop Mode greyed),
    C00A93BC regcropeff (Crop Mode effectively off), C005C054 regseltail (after a resolution
    change: apply + change event on the resolution and crop records; crop toggled once when
    the standby look changes so Quick Set rebuilds the live view).

Reading a section map: python3 -c 'import struct;d=open("fpSup.BIN","rb").read();
  n=struct.unpack_from("<I",d,4)[0];print([struct.unpack_from("<II",d,16+8*i) for i in range(n)])'
